course: Harvard CS249r: Architecture 2.0 - Agentic AI for Computer Systems Design (Fall 2025)

schema_definition.title: Full paper title
schema_definition.cs249r_week: Corresponding week in Harvard CS249r Fall 2025 schedule (Weeks 1-13)
schema_definition.hardware_target: Target execution substrate (e.g., ASIC/FPGA RTL, NVIDIA H100/A100 CUDA, Datacenter CPU/WSC, Multi-Node Cluster)
schema_definition.agent_paradigm: Primary agentic loop or optimization methodology
schema_definition.verifier_type: Ground-truth evaluator in the loop (e.g., Icarus Verilog/Verilator, Synopsys DC, nvcc+CUDA Profiler, LLVM/mca, Real OS/K8s)
schema_definition.pass_at_1: Functional correctness or task success rate (%) at k=1 sample
schema_definition.pass_at_10: Functional correctness or task success rate (%) at k=10 (or multi-turn budget)
schema_definition.verifier_latency_share_pct: Percentage of end-to-end agentic episode wall-clock time spent inside the external verifier/simulator/profiler (%)
schema_definition.token_amplification_factor: Ratio of total tokens processed/generated across multi-turn reflection/search to single-shot zero-shot baseline tokens
schema_definition.kv_cache_reuse_ratio: Fraction of prompt/context KV blocks shared across turns or branches (0.0 to 1.0)
schema_definition.speedup_over_baseline: Normalized speedup, PPA improvement, or throughput multiplier relative to standard baseline (1.0x = parity)
schema_definition.avg_turn_count: Average number of environment-verifier interaction turns per task

papers.title: VerilogEval: Evaluating Large Language Models for Verilog Code Generation
papers.hardware_target: ASIC/FPGA RTL (Verilog-2001)
papers.agent_paradigm: Supervised Fine-Tuning + Multi-Sample Testbench Filtering
papers.verifier_type: Icarus Verilog (iverilog) Cycle-Accurate Testbench
papers.key_insight: Synthetic description-to-RTL pairs boost pass@10 by +22.3% over pass@1 when paired with automated Icarus Verilog testbenches.

papers.title: RTLCoder: Outperforming GPT-3.5 in Design RTL Generation with Our Open-Source Dataset and Lightweight Solution
papers.hardware_target: ASIC/FPGA Synthesizable RTL
papers.agent_paradigm: Automated Keyword-Guided Data Synthesis + Quality-Scored Alignment
papers.verifier_type: iverilog + Synopsys Design Compiler Syntax/Synthesis Check
papers.key_insight: Domain-specific 7B model trained on simulator-verified RTL candidates outperforms commercial LLMs at 4-bit quantization.

papers.title: ChipNeMo: Domain-Adapted LLMs for Chip Design
papers.hardware_target: Industrial GPU SoC & EDA Tcl/Python Scripts
papers.agent_paradigm: Domain-Adaptive Pretraining (DAPT) + Domain RAG + Tool Chatbot
papers.verifier_type: NVIDIA Internal EDA Flow (VCS / Genus / Innovus Tcl Interpreter)
papers.baseline_name: Base LLaMA2-13B on EDA Script Generation
papers.key_insight: Custom tokenizer adaptation (+9k HDL/EDA tokens) reduces token count by 16-33% and paired with domain RAG matches 70B models using a 13B backbone.

papers.title: ChatEDA: A Large Language Model Powered Autonomous Agent for EDA
papers.authors_short: Wu et al. (CUHK / Shanghai AI Lab)
papers.hardware_target: RTL-to-GDSII Physical Design Flow
papers.agent_paradigm: Task Decomposition Planner + Script Generator + OpenROAD Execution Loop
papers.verifier_type: OpenROAD + Yosys + iEDA RTL-to-GDSII Toolchain
papers.baseline_name: ReAct GPT-4 Baseline on OpenROAD Flows
papers.key_insight: Physical synthesis and placement dominate 89.4% of episode latency, making hierarchical script planning far superior to fine-grained step-by-step ReAct.

papers.title: Make Every Move Count: LLM-based High-Quality RTL Code Generation Using MCTS
papers.hardware_target: PPA-Optimized Synthesizable Adder/MAC/FSM Modules
papers.agent_paradigm: Monte Carlo Tree Search (MCTS) over Token/AST Trajectories with PPA Reward
papers.verifier_type: Yosys + ABC Logic Synthesis (Area-Delay Product Reward)
papers.key_insight: Coupling UCT tree search with ABC synthesis feedback achieves up to 31.8% Area-Delay Product reduction over naive LLM generation.

papers.title: CVDP: Comprehensive Verilog Design Problems for Evaluating LLMs and Agents on RTL Design and Verification
papers.hardware_target: Multi-File Industrial RTL & SystemVerilog Verification
papers.agent_paradigm: Multi-Turn Agentic Code-Test-Repair Loop in Dockerized EDA
papers.verifier_type: Verilator + SymbiYosys Formal + Cocotb Verification Suite
papers.key_insight: Exposes the sharp drop from toy VerilogEval to 13-category multi-file RTL debugging and formal assertion synthesis.

papers.title: Using LLMs to Facilitate Formal Verification of RTL ( & AssertLLM )
papers.authors_short: Orenes-Vera et al. (Princeton) / Fang et al.
papers.hardware_target: SystemVerilog Assertions (SVA) & Formal Property Engines
papers.agent_paradigm: Spec-Decomposition Multi-Agent + Counterexample-Guided Refinement
papers.verifier_type: Cadence JasperGold / SymbiYosys Bounded Model Checker
papers.baseline_name: Unassisted Formal Verification SVA Coverage Rate
papers.key_insight: Feeding formal model-checker counterexample traces back to an assertion-repair agent closes 79.2% of specification properties.

papers.title: KernelBench: Can LLMs Write Efficient GPU Kernels?
papers.authors_short: Ouyang et al. (Stanford Scaling Intelligence Lab)
papers.hardware_target: NVIDIA H100 / A100 GPUs (CUDA C++ & Triton)
papers.agent_paradigm: Iterative Execution + Compiler Error & Nsight Profiler Feedback
papers.verifier_type: nvcc Compiler + PyTorch Numerical Check + CUDA Event Timer
papers.key_insight: Single-shot LLMs fail on register pressure and shared-memory bank conflicts, whereas 10-turn profiler feedback triples fast_1 success.

papers.title: Kevin: Multi-Turn RL for Generating CUDA Kernels
papers.authors_short: Baronio, Rush et al. (Cornell / Cursor / Stanford)
papers.hardware_target: NVIDIA H100 SXM5 (Custom CUDA Operator Fusion)
papers.agent_paradigm: Multi-Turn Reinforcement Learning with Execution/Speedup Rewards
papers.verifier_type: Isolated GPU Sandbox + nvcc + Hardware Cycle Timer
papers.key_insight: Training over multi-turn trajectories teaches the agent to first establish functional correctness and then iteratively apply shared-memory tiling and warp-level primitives.

papers.title: AlphaDev: Faster Sorting Algorithms Discovered Using Deep Reinforcement Learning
papers.hardware_target: x86-64 / ARMv8 CPU Assembly Instruction Sequences
papers.agent_paradigm: AlphaZero MCTS Assembly Game + CPU Latency/Correctness Reward
papers.verifier_type: x86/ARM Emulator + SMT Equivalence Checker + Hardware Perf Counters
papers.baseline_name: libc++ std::sort Short-Sequence Routines (Sort-3 to Sort-5)
papers.key_insight: Discovered novel 'AlphaDev swap and copy moves' in assembly that bypass branch instructions, upstreamed into LLVM libc++.

papers.title: Meta Large Language Model Compiler: Foundation Models of Compiler Optimization
papers.hardware_target: LLVM IR & x86/ARM Code Size & Throughput
papers.agent_paradigm: LLVM-IR Pretrained Foundation Model + Autotuning Pass Search
papers.verifier_type: LLVM opt + clang Assembler + llvm-mca / Cycle Timer
papers.key_insight: Pretraining on 546B tokens of LLVM IR and assembly enables accurate pass-list prediction and disassembly without millions of slow compiler invocations.

papers.title: FunSearch & AlphaEvolve: Evolutionary Coding Agents for Mathematical and Systems Discovery
papers.authors_short: Romera-Paredes et al. / Novikov et al. (Google DeepMind)
papers.hardware_target: TPU v5e/v6e Matrix Multiplication Kernels & Borg Scheduling
papers.agent_paradigm: Island-Based Evolutionary Program Database + Gemini Code Mutation
papers.verifier_type: Automated Sandboxed Evaluator + TPU Kernel Profiler
papers.key_insight: Evolutionary search with fast program verifiers achieves 23% kernel speedup on Gemini training kernels and 0.7% global fleet compute recovery.

papers.title: ECO: An LLM-Driven Efficient Code Optimizer for Warehouse Scale Computers
papers.hardware_target: Google Warehouse-Scale Computers (C++ Production Binaries)
papers.agent_paradigm: Telemetry-Guided Patch Generation + Build/Test/Benchmark Loop
papers.verifier_type: Bazel Build + Unit Test Suite + Google-Wide Profiling (GWP) Microbenchmark
papers.baseline_name: Production C++ Fleet Hotspots under FDO/ThinLTO
papers.key_insight: Closes the loop between fleet-wide continuous profiling counters and LLM refactoring, saving millions of CPU cores in production WSCs.

papers.title: ArchGym: An Open-Source Gymnasium for Machine Learning Assisted Architecture Design
papers.hardware_target: Custom DNN Accelerators, SoCs & Memory Controllers
papers.agent_paradigm: Standardized RL/BO/ACO/GA Agent Gymnasium over Architecture Simulators
papers.verifier_type: Timeloop / Maestro / DRAMSys / gem5 Cycle Simulators
papers.baseline_name: Heuristic Grid/Random DSE Baseline under Fixed Sample Budget
papers.key_insight: Demonstrates the 'no free lunch' principle in architecture DSE: hyperparameters dominate search agent choice, and simulator latency (>90%) is the primary bottleneck.

papers.title: Concorde: Fast and Accurate CPU Performance Modeling with Compositional Analytical-ML Fusion
papers.hardware_target: Out-of-Order Superscalar Server CPUs
papers.agent_paradigm: Compositional Analytical First-Order Queueing + ML Residual Surrogate
papers.verifier_type: Hybrid Analytical Pipeline + gem5 Calibration Verifier
papers.baseline_name: Cycle-Level Microarchitectural Simulation Throughput (5 orders of mag, capped 5x in normalized scale)
papers.key_insight: Replaces slow cycle-accurate gem5 verification with compositional analytical-ML surrogates (<2% CPI error), slashing verifier overhead from >90% to 14.5%.

papers.title: COSMIC: Enabling Full-Stack Co-Design and Optimization of Distributed Machine Learning Systems
papers.authors_short: Rashidi, Maas et al. (Google / Georgia Tech)
papers.hardware_target: Distributed TPU/GPU Pods (Compute + Collectives + Fabric Topology)
papers.agent_paradigm: Cross-Layer Multi-Objective Agentic Search (Parallelism + Network + HW)
papers.verifier_type: ASTRA-sim Distributed System Simulator + Collective Analytical Cost Model
papers.key_insight: Jointly optimizing parallelism strategy, collective scheduling, and interconnect bandwidth yields 1.58x higher TFLOPs/$ than layer-isolated tuning.

papers.title: QuArch: A Question-Answering Dataset for AI Agents in Computer Architecture
papers.authors_short: agiannou, Reddi et al. (Harvard Edge Lab)
papers.hardware_target: Processor Microarchitecture, Cache Coherence, Virtual Memory & ISA
papers.agent_paradigm: Chain-of-Thought + Retrieval-Augmented Architectural Reasoning
papers.verifier_type: 1,500-Question Expert-Verified Computer Architecture Evaluation Harness
papers.baseline_name: Base Open-Weights LLM Accuracy on Microarchitecture Reasoning
papers.key_insight: Reveals systematic blind spots in frontier LLMs regarding quantitative pipeline hazards, coherence state transitions, and memory ordering.

papers.title: OSWorld: Benchmarking Multimodal Agents for Open-Ended Tasks in Real Computer Environments
papers.hardware_target: Ubuntu / Windows / macOS Live VM Environments (369 Real Tasks)
papers.agent_paradigm: Multimodal Screenshot + Accessibility Tree Observation-Action Loop
papers.verifier_type: VM State Inspection Scripts (File System, DB, Process & UI Post-Conditions)
papers.baseline_name: Text-Only A11y Agent vs Hybrid Vision-Action Agent
papers.key_insight: Long-horizon OS workflows suffer compounding grounding errors and state drift across applications without VM snapshot rollback.

papers.title: RCACopilot & AIOpsLab: Autonomous Cloud Root-Cause Analysis and Incident Mitigation Agents
papers.hardware_target: Kubernetes Microservice Clusters & Cloud Telemetry Pipelines
papers.agent_paradigm: Diagnostic Handler Workflow + Log/Metric/Trace Tool-Use Agent
papers.verifier_type: Live Fault-Injection K8s Cluster (ChaosMesh + Prometheus Validator)
papers.key_insight: Structured telemetry summarization before agent reasoning prevents context-window overflow from raw distributed logs and cuts MTTM by 3.1x.

papers.title: SGLang: Efficient Execution of Structured Language Model Programs
papers.hardware_target: Multi-GPU LLM Serving Clusters (NVIDIA A100/H100)
papers.agent_paradigm: RadixAttention Automatic KV-Cache Prefix Tree + Compressed Finite-State Decoding
papers.verifier_type: FSM Regex/JSON Schema Validator + GPU Memory Manager
papers.baseline_name: Guidance / vLLM Baseline without Radix Prefix Caching on Agent Trees
papers.key_insight: RadixAttention retains KV-cache blocks in an LRU radix tree across multi-turn agent calls and MCTS branches, yielding up to 5x-6.4x higher throughput.

papers.title: Efficient Memory Management for Large Language Model Serving with PagedAttention (vLLM)
papers.hardware_target: Datacenter GPU HBM (Virtual-to-Physical KV Block Tables)
papers.agent_paradigm: OS-Inspired Paged Virtual Memory + Copy-on-Write Parallel Sampling
papers.verifier_type: Block-Table Memory Allocator & Preemption Scheduler
papers.key_insight: Eliminates internal/external HBM fragmentation (<4% waste), enabling high-batch parallel sampling and beam/tree search for coding agents.

papers.title: Taming Throughput-Latency Tradeoff in LLM Inference with Sarathi-Serve
papers.authors_short: Agrawal et al. (Microsoft Research / Georgia Tech)
papers.hardware_target: Multi-GPU Pipeline-Parallel Inference Nodes
papers.agent_paradigm: Chunked-Prefill + Stall-Free Piggybacked Decode Scheduling
papers.verifier_type: SLO Latency Monitor (TTFT & TBT P99 Enforcer)
papers.baseline_name: Iteration-Level Batching without Chunked Prefill under Long Agent Contexts
papers.key_insight: Long tool-output prefills in agentic loops cause severe decode stalls; chunked prefill co-batches prefill chunks with ongoing decode tokens for 3.8x capacity.

papers.title: Efficient LLM Scheduling by Learning to Rank
papers.authors_short: Fu et al. (UCSD / Microsoft Azure Research)
papers.hardware_target: Cloud LLM Serving Clusters under Variable Generation Lengths
papers.agent_paradigm: OPT-In-Flight Output Length Ranking Predictor + Shortest-Remaining-Job-First (SJF)
papers.verifier_type: Small Ranking Model (Kendall-Tau Rank Evaluator) + Preemptive Queue
papers.key_insight: Predicting relative output token length via listwise learning-to-rank avoids head-of-line blocking from long reasoning trajectories, cutting P90 latency by 2.8x.

papers.title: S-LoRA: Serving Thousands of Concurrent LoRA Adapters
papers.hardware_target: Unified HBM Pool for Base Weights + Dynamic LoRA Ranks + KV Cache
papers.agent_paradigm: Unified Paging for Heterogeneous LoRA Adapters + CustomMBGMM CUDA Kernels
papers.verifier_type: Unified Page Allocator + Tensor Parallel Adapter Router
papers.key_insight: Enables multi-agent Role/Skill specialization (planner, coder, verifier, critic adapters) on a single base model in HBM with 4x throughput.

papers.title: CacheBlend: Fast Large Language Model Serving for RAG with Cached Knowledge Fusion
papers.hardware_target: GPU HBM + Host DRAM Disaggregated KV Hierarchy
papers.agent_paradigm: Precomputed Document KV Chunks + Selective ~15% Cross-Attention Recalculation
papers.verifier_type: Attention-Deviation Selector + Pipelined Layer-Wise KV Loader
papers.baseline_name: Full-Prefill RAG / Recompute Baseline on Long Agent Contexts
papers.key_insight: Recomputing cross-attention on only ~15% of high-deviation tokens allows arbitrary composition of cached RAG/tool chunks at 3.3x lower TTFT.
